Built for Swiss residents, this free calculator projects investment growth in CHF with a Financial Independence indicator — it tells you when your portfolio could cover your living costs. Includes Swiss benchmarks (Pillar 3a, savings rates, ETFs), shareable URLs, and real return scenarios. No signup. No ads. No paywall.

records.name: Evercrypted
records.tagline: Messaging app with password encrypted messages and much more
records.description: When end-to-end encryption is not enough - encrypt messages with post-quantum algorithms, passwords and type with protected keyboard. Evercrypted adds another layer of security on top of Post-Quantum End-to-End cryptography by password-protecting your messages and providing a built-in-app keyboard that key-loggers cannot track. No phone number required. Not free, no gifs or emojis, but open-source.

records.name: Flowchart AI
records.tagline: Build flowcharts instantly with AI in your browser
records.description: Flowchart AI is launching on Product Hunt with our new Web version. Simply describe your process, and AI automatically generates a structured flowchart for you. Visualize business workflows, project processes, approval flows, and operational systems without starting from scratch. Even rough ideas are transformed into clear diagrams, and you can refine them visually or edit directly using Mermaid notation. Export, share, and continue editing across devices with Google Drive integration.

records.name: Curate
records.tagline: Swipe Your Style
records.description: Curate is a personal style app that helps you discover and organize what to wear. Swipe through a curated feed of clothing pieces, save favorites in one place, and revisit them anytime. When you're ready, open each item directly at the retailer.

records.name: TrustSignal
records.tagline: See your SaaS company the way your buyers see it.
records.description: TrustSignal scans the public-facing presence of any SaaS company and produces a Trust Readiness Score in under 60 seconds. What it checks: • Security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options) • Email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) • Privacy policy presence and completeness • Terms of service accessibility • Cookie consent and configuration • Subprocessor disclosure • Security page and compliance signals Free to use. No signup required. Enter any URL and see what the outside world sees.

records.name: Eventocam | QR Guest Photo Sharing
records.tagline: Collect guest photos via QR—no apps, no registration.
records.description: Eventocam is a web-based platform designed to centralize event photos and videos in real-time. By replacing traditional photo booths with custom QR codes, guests can upload high-resolution media directly from their mobile browsers—no app downloads required. Key features include private password-protected galleries, real-time live slideshows, and full custom branding. Perfect for weddings, corporate events, and parties globally.

records.name: Metrica
records.tagline: Performance Analytics
records.description: Metrica is a lightweight Windows performance and graphics analysis tool designed to monitor system resources, visualize GPU and CPU usage, and simplify device optimization with a modern, minimal interface.

records.name: Airesumify
records.tagline: Free AI resume builder. ATS-optimized. just signup needed.
records.description: Airesumify is a free AI resume builder that creates ATS-optimized resumes in 5 minutes — no signup required. Most resume builders are expensive, clunky, or produce generic output that fails ATS screening. Airesumify fixes this with AI that tailors your resume to the job, optimizes keywords, and formats it to pass the automated filters used by 90% of employers. ✅ Free — no credit card, no trial ✅ ATS checker built-in ✅ Instant PDF download ✅ Mobile-friendly

records.name: keychains.dev
records.tagline: Give AI access to 6754+ APIs with zero credentials exposed
records.description: Keychains.dev is a secure credential proxy for AI agents. Use "keychains curl" as a drop-in for curl — just replace hard-coded credentials with template variables like {{GITHUB_TOKEN}}. Keychains injects real credentials server-side. Your agent never sees raw secrets — immune to prompt injection by design. Users approve each permission with one click and can revoke access anytime. Full audit trail. Works with 11,000+ API providers (OAuth, API keys, basic auth).

records.name: HookAI
records.tagline: Generate viral hook videos in 30 seconds with AI
records.description: HookAI creates scroll-stopping hook videos for any niche in 30 seconds. Pick your topic, choose a voice and background — get a ready-to-post MP4 with AI copywriting + voiceover in 32 languages. Perfect for content creators, marketers, and businesses who want to win the first 3 seconds of attention. ✅ Try free — no credit card required ✅ 32 languages ✅ 9 hook styles ✅ Custom backgrounds + voice selection ✅ Download ready-to-post MP4s ready to post on TikTok, Reels & Shorts.

records.name: Hebbian Mind
records.tagline: AI memory that learns which concepts belong together
records.description: Hebbian Mind is an open source MCP memory server that implements real Hebbian learning. Concepts that activate together form stronger connections — no manual curation needed. Connections weaken through disuse via temporal decay. Built with dual-write architecture (RAM + disk) for crash safety, sub-millisecond reads, Docker deployment, and homeostatic scaling to prevent weight saturation. The only MCP server with actual Hebbian learning — zero competitors in this category.

records.name: ScamLens
records.tagline: Check if any website is a scam — free & instant
records.description: ScamLens helps you verify if any website is safe, legitimate, or a scam — before you get tricked. Simply enter any URL to get an instant trust score powered by multi-source threat intelligence, community reports, and AI analysis. Free, no sign-up required, available in 12 languages. Unlike other tools, ScamLens combines real-time data from multiple security sources with crowdsourced user reports, giving you a more accurate and up-to-date safety verdict.intelligence powered by AI.

records.name: LucidChat
records.tagline: Keep AI sharp — manage context at the turn level.
records.description: Long AI conversations lose quality. One bad turn pollutes everything after it. Starting over means losing all your context. ﻿ LucidChat lets you manage every turn independently. Mute noisy turns. Pin critical ones. Track active context in real-time. Keep AI sharp without starting from scratch. ﻿ A side-by-side note panel lets you pull key fragments from chat and assemble them into polished content — far better than one-shot generation. ﻿ 🟢 Free during Early Access. Evolving with your feedback.

records.name: Wyapy
records.tagline: Developer satisfaction tracking inside Jira workflows
records.description: Wyapy now integrates directly into Jira workflows to capture structured developer feedback when work is completed. When an issue transitions to Done, teams can rate overall satisfaction and key aspects like requirements clarity, collaboration, or solution quality. Feedback is aggregated into dashboards by project and sprint. At sprint close, Wyapy generates AI-powered summaries highlighting patterns, risks, and improvement signals to support retrospectives and continuous improvement.

records.name: alfred_
records.tagline: AI Executive Assistant for Email, Calendar, & To Dos
records.description: Modern work is fragmented. Email creates tasks. Tasks affect your calendar. Your calendar creates more email. But none of your tools talk to each other. alfred_ is an AI executive assistant that unifies your inbox, calendar, and to dos into one intelligent dashboard. It surfaces what matters, turns messages into clear next steps, and helps you stay ahead without living in your inbox. Stop managing work. Start doing it.

records.name: CSV to CSA Software Assurance 2026
records.tagline: Computer System Validation to CSA Explained
records.description: Understanding Classic Computer System Validation (CSV) and the transition to Computer Software Assurance (CSA) for FDA-regulated industries. This expert-led training explains risk-based validation, 21 CFR Part 11 expectations, data integrity requirements, and practical implementation strategies. Designed for quality, validation, IT, and compliance professionals navigating modern CSA guidance in 2026.

records.name: Traversity
records.tagline: Calmer, concierge-style travel planning
records.description: Traversity is a travel planning service that minimizes the hassle of planning your trip. No more tab searching, screenshots or disorganized notes. We help you plan your trip the right way. Itinerary, recommendations and support all included. We make sure the travel experience is special and not chaotic. This launch emphasizes the servicing model before launching the servicing platform.

records.name: Best Business Consultant Company
records.tagline: BusinessConsultantCompany
records.description: Rudra Management Consultancies stands among the best business consultant companies in Dubai, offering expert guidance for mainland, free zone, and offshore company formation. From trade license approvals to visa processing, banking assistance, and compliance support, Rudra delivers end-to-end solutions tailored to entrepreneurs, startups, and international investors.

records.name: Timeline Studio
records.tagline: Plan timelines, estimate costs, and forecast with AI
records.description: Timeline Studio uses AI to turn a project description into tasks, effort estimates, dependencies, and a Gantt chart in seconds. Great for quick drafts, client proposals, or early-stage scoping. AI generates cost estimates, builds timelines, analyzes risks, and explains simulation impacts in plain language. Also includes drag-and-drop Gantt charts, dependency arrows, cost sheets, and what-if simulation. Pilot release - your feedback will shape what comes next.

records.name: Themostat Game
records.tagline: Hilarious party game inspired by TikTok
records.description: Thermostat Game turns learning about home energy into a fun challenge. Adjust temperatures, manage HVAC settings, and optimize comfort while saving energy in engaging gameplay. Explore levels that teach real-world thermostat strategies, discover efficient habits, and compete with your best scores. Perfect for curious minds, homeowners, and anyone who wants to make smarter energy choices — all in an entertaining app experience.

records.name: Master Golang
records.tagline: The Go course that ends in production
records.description: Master Golang is a project-first Go course that takes you from zero to a live production deployment. Real auth, PostgreSQL, Templ, Datastar, Docker, VPS. 13+ hours, 40+ lessons. One payment. Lifetime access.

records.name: Express Headshot AI
records.tagline: Studio-quality AI headshots from a single selfie (iOS)
records.description: Create realistic, professional headshots in seconds from just one selfie. Choose outfit style and color, studio/office/outdoor backgrounds, lighting (natural to dramatic), and expressions. Export in aspect ratios optimized for LinkedIn, Instagram, and CVs—no 10–20 photo uploads, no long waiting times.

records.name: OneNotary API – Enterprise RON
records.tagline: Enterprise-Grade Remote Online Notarization Infrastructure
records.description: OneNotary provides enterprise-grade Remote Online Notarization (RON) infrastructure through a secure, developer-friendly API. Designed for regulated industries, our platform enables fully embedded, compliant notarization workflows with built-in identity verification, encrypted session recording, and audit-ready controls. Integrated with partners like DocuSign, Clio, and CoreLogic.

records.name: ramadan-cli
records.tagline: CLI to check Sehar & Iftar times anywhere in the world
records.description: npx ramadan-cli CLI to check Sehar/Iftar times in Ramadan anywhere in the world. Built for humans and agents. Many users using with OpenClaw or their coding agents. Why You'll Like It 🌙 Ramadan-only output focused on Sehar/Iftar 📍 Auto first-run setup (city, country, method, school, timezone) ✨ Highlights current + next Sehar/Iftar with countdown 🗓 -a, --all for complete Ramadan month 🔢 -n, --number for a specific roza day 📟 -s --status for coding agents 🧹 One-command reset (reset)

records.name: FreeLens Flow
records.tagline: The freelance project manager built for deep work
records.description: FreeLens Flow is a project management tool built specifically for freelancers. Unlike generic tools like Trello or Asana, it combines client management, project tracking, keads, invoicing, and deep work sessions in one place — no integrations needed. We built it because freelancers don't work like teams, so their tools shouldn't either. Whether you're juggling 3 clients or 30, Flow keeps you focused and organized.

records.name: Dock Hosting
records.tagline: Real-time hosting with instant rollbacks and team sync.
records.description: Free cloud hosting platform for WordPress, Docker containers, Node.js, Python, Go, PHP & more. One-click deploy, automatic SSL, databases, and GitHub integration.

records.name: Adamas aged bronze wall light
records.tagline: A visually exciting Australian made aged bronze wall light
records.description: Machined in our Australian factory, the Adamas wall light is made from solid brass and treated to aged bronze. The knurled shell leaves a pattern from which the age bronze wall light gets its name Adamas, ancient Greek for diamond. Usually used from grip, the diamond knurling adds a visual detail that reflects our history of machining and a bit of rockstar glam to your lights.

records.name: mcpdrop.com
records.tagline: The MCP server directory — 166+ servers, one place
records.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is how AI agents connect to the real world — databases, browsers, APIs, search, Slack, whatever. The ecosystem exploded and nobody built a proper directory. So we did. 166 servers across 12 categories. Searchable, filterable, free to list. If your AI agent needs to talk to something, there's probably already an MCP server for it. Now there's one place to find them.

records.name: KVTemplate
records.tagline: Crea tu Bio Página y Menús QR dinámicos en solo 2 minutos.
records.description: Crea tu identidad digital en minutos. Con KVTemplate puedes unificar tus redes sociales en una bio-página personalizada, gestiona menús con un QR dinámico que puedes actualizar en tiempo real sin volver a imprimir y vende tus platos por el what's. Todo desde un panel intuitivo.

records.name: TraderMap
records.tagline: Whale tracking, AI trading & market insights — free
records.description: With Tradermap, you can track real-time whale trades and liquidations across major exchanges. You can also follow crypto news, whale prediction trades, the economic calendar, and more, all in one place. We also built an AI Trader Agent trained by expert analysts and trading books. It thinks like a human, learns from mistakes, and can be watched 24/7. Tradermap is completely free. We worked hard to make this possible and we’re proud we did.

records.name: Split
records.tagline: Divida despesas de forma simples e justa.
records.description: Splitwise.com.br is a Brazilian-focused expense sharing platform that helps friends, couples, and groups easily split bills and keep track of shared expenses. Designed specifically for the Brazilian public, it offers a simple and intuitive way to divide costs from trips, barbecues, rent, parties, and everyday activities, making sure everyone pays their fair share without confusion.

records.name: My Market Study - Ai-gen market studies
records.tagline: A $50K McKinsey-type market study that now costs you $89.90
records.description: Get a professional market study + presentation slides with named competitors, real market data, and financial projections — the same research big companies pay $10K+ for. From $89.90. On top, a starter presentation based on your generated study in PPTX and HTML. Preview study is FREE, you can generate it to see the results!

records.name: Hobbeetat
records.tagline: Ready to discover your next favorite hobby?
records.description: Connect, Create, Cultivate. The social hive for your hobbies. Join Hobbeetat to discover new passions, connect with fellow hobbyists, and grow your skills.

records.name: DocIA
records.tagline: DocIA is a privacy-first document intelligence assistant.
records.description: DocIA: Open-source AI-powered document scanning, extraction, and regeneration platform. Powered by AI for document scanning, data extraction, and template management. Connect to cloud AI providers or use local models for complete privacy.

records.name: Focus AI
records.tagline: Focus AI | The smartest way to plan your day 🚀
records.description: AI-driven productivity planner. Add tasks via text or voice and let AI pick your priorities. Simple, fast, and stress-free.

records.name: Scarcity
records.tagline: Instant-play browser battle royale. No downloads.
records.description: I wanted to build a game that respects the player's time—something you can boot up in a new tab and instantly experience the adrenaline of a shrinking zone, scarce resources, and intense combat without navigating a maze of menus or downloading a heavy client. You spawn in an arena with 49 AI-driven opponents. Your health drains if you stay outside the shrinking red zone, and your hunger steadily drops, forcing you to constantly move, scavenge for glowing food, and fight over resources.

records.name: Patent Search Generator
records.tagline: AI-powered Boolean search queries for Google Patents
records.description: Patent Search Generator automates Google Patents searches! Type your invention description and get three AI-generated Boolean search queries — broad, moderate, and narrow — optimized for Google Patents or Orbit/Quartet. The AI extracts key concepts, generates technical synonyms, and builds properly formatted queries.

records.name: MemoLife Planner Pro
records.tagline: Votre héritage, protégé et organisé
records.description: MemoLife Master : L’ultime coffre-fort d’héritage numérique. Ne laissez plus vos proches dans le chaos administratif. Ce logiciel professionnel sécurise vos accès bancaires, directives, mots de passe et biens physiques dans une interface bilingue (FR/EN). Contrairement au Cloud, vos données restent 100% privées sur votre ordinateur. Points forts : Sécurité maximale avec mot de passe maître Export USB et impression PDF Multi-catégories (Banques, Crypto, Santé) Sans abonnement.

records.name: Claudebin
records.tagline: Export and share your Claude Code sessions as resumable URLs
records.description: Claude Code runs in your terminal. Session data is stored locally, but not in a human-readable format. If the session contains useful context, refactors, tool usage, reviewing or sharing it isn’t straightforward. Claudebin lets you export a Claude Code session. It captures: - the full message thread - file reads/writes - bash commands - web and MCP calls It returns a URL with a structured, navigable viewer. You can link it in a PR, embed a selected range in your docs, or resume it locally.

records.name: Guideless
records.tagline: Create AI-narrated software video guides in minutes
records.description: We built Guideless out of frustration with existing walkthrough tools. Everything we tried felt bloated with unnecessary features and still produced mediocre output. So we obsessed over UX and output quality. We built effortless capture with auto-generated captions, added AI refinements, and a wide selection of natural-sounding, multi-language AI voiceovers. The result is on-brand guides that look clean, sound premium by default, and can be instantly shared, embedded, or exported to MP4.

records.name: ATO - AI Tab Organizer | Tab Manager
records.tagline: AI Tab Organizer, Tab Management, Chrome Extension
records.description: Transform tab chaos into a structured workspace with ATO. Powered by AI, it automatically groups tabs by context, usage, or recency. 🚀 Why ATO? • Auto-grouping: One-click or real-time organization. • AI Semantic Sorting: Context-aware categories (Work, News, etc). * Tab Obeserver: A revolutionary tool to view and organize your tabs • More Tools: Clean duplicates, rename tabs, and instant search. Stop hunting for tabs. Let ATO streamline your workflow. Browsing just got smarter.

records.name: SimpleSplit
records.tagline: Minimal workout tracking for lifters with a plan
records.description: SimpleSplit is the workout tracker that respects your data ownership. Log lifts with clean sets/reps/weight tracking, build custom days, and schedule workout splits. Export your entire workout history to Excel anytime. Features offline-first design, cloud sync via Supabase, bodyweight tracking, specific exercise progression and other progress statistics. Built for lifters who have a plan and want a simple way to organize and view it.

records.name: Real MidnightClub
records.tagline: Real-time minimap of the automotive world.
records.description: The newest and most exclusive way to live your passion for cars. The minimap that connects the entire automotive scene — in real time. (Racing game style) See other people in real time on the minimap, events, challenges on the streets. Add vehicles to your garage, create your club with friends, join the network, posts, moments, rankings and much more.

records.name: Video Maker AI
records.tagline: Turn any text into a 2D animated video in seconds
records.description: Video Maker AI turns any text into a fully animated 2D video in seconds. No editing. No skills. 100% automated. ✨ Features • Automatic scene generation • Modern 2D animations • AI voice-over (6 languages) • Auto subtitles • Branding & HD export 🚀 Early Access Lifetime access + up to 10 videos/month.

records.name: Memorial
records.tagline: Create beautiful digital memorials for loved ones
records.description: Memorial is a simple and beautiful way to create lasting digital memorial pages. Create a personalized tribute with photos, stories, and meaningful moments. Invite family and friends to contribute and keep memories preserved in one dedicated space. Built with simplicity, privacy, and emotional design in mind, Memorial makes honoring loved ones easier in a digital world.

records.name: Kamero.ai: AI Event Photo Sharing
records.tagline: Real-time AI Face Recognition & Instant Camera - Cloud Sync
records.description: Kamero.ai is a mobile-first AI photo-sharing platform that eliminates the "waiting game" for event photos. Unlike generic cloud storage, we offer: • Kam-Sync: Real-time FTP camera-to-cloud upload. • AI Face Match: Guests find their photos in seconds with a selfie. • White-Label Apps: Photographers deliver under their own brand. • Privacy-First: Secure PINs and face-based access controls. Stop using Google Drive for events. Start delivering memories in real-time.

records.name: DubCall AI Voice Agents
records.tagline: 24×7 AI Voice Agents for Sales, Support & Appointments
records.description: SMEs lose revenue because calls go unanswered, staff is expensive, and 24×7 support isn’t affordable. DubCall provides AI voice agents that autonomously handle inbound & outbound calls — qualify leads, book appointments, answer FAQs. Lightweight setup (hours, not weeks), flat SaaS pricing + controlled usage, and proprietary AI that reduces voice infra cost by ~70%. Already handling 4,900+ calls for our first client with 50% cost savings.

records.name: Goldytools Import PST to Office 365
records.tagline: Import PST to Office 365
records.description: Goldytools Import PST to Office 365 is a professional migration solution designed to securely transfer PST files into Microsoft 365 (Office 365) mailboxes without data loss.

records.name: Metabolic Center
records.tagline: AI that analyzes your blood tests and tells you what to fix
records.description: Upload a photo of your blood test results — get a full metabolic health report in 60 seconds. 🧬 Metabolic Score (0-100) 🔬 Biological age estimate ⚠️ Risk alerts your doctor missed 💊 Personalized supplement protocol 🥗 Nutrition & lifestyle plan 📸 Food scanner — photo meals, get calories & metabolic impact Uses functional medicine optimal ranges, not standard lab "normal." Because 88% of adults are metabolically unhealthy — most just don't know it yet Free to try via Telegram bot. 2 analyses

records.name: SmartStudyMatch.com
records.tagline: Find the best country, state, and university to study, now
records.description: .SmartStudyMatch.com helps international students compare study destinations across countries, U.S. states, and top universities using real factors like cost, admissions flexibility, lifestyle, work rights, and academic fit. No rankings. No ads. No accounts. Compare countries and U.S. states, get personalized matches based on budget, GPA, and degree level, and explore top universities clearly, privately, and fast.

records.name: Apex Browser
records.tagline: The desktop-class browser built exclusively for iPad
records.description: Apex Browser brings true desktop browsing to iPad — built exclusively for iPadOS 26. Most iPad browsers are scaled-up iPhone apps. Apex is different, engineered for iPad power users who want a real desktop experience. - Split-View Browsing — two sites side-by-side - Arc-Style Sidebar with drag-and-drop tabs - Triple-Layer Ad Blocking - Metal 4 Acceleration - Desktop Mode forced on every site - Zero data collection, ever
